item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00225","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C20","C09"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.84,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 is a recent executive order using the same concrete national-forest enlargement template: recitals identify federally controlled lands intended for inclusion in a named national forest, presidential approval of the underlying transfer, a finding that the lands are suitable for national-forest purposes and that inclusion would serve the public interest, followed by detailed parcel descriptions. The child materially expands this machinery to multiple acquisition authorities, present and future acquisitions, boundary extensions, and a prior-reservation revocation. C20 is strong for the future-acquisition mechanism, while C09 is an earlier close analogue of C05, but C05 is the strongest overall drafting template.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS it appears that the above-described lands are suitable for national-forest purposes and that it would be in the public interest to reserve such lands as parts of the Nicolet National Forest or the Chequamegon National Forest","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS it appears that such lands are suitable for national-forest purposes and that the inclusion of such lands in the Nantahala National Forest would be in the public interest","explanation":"Distinctive near-verbatim national-forest suitability and public-interest finding."},{"child_excerpt":"NOW, THEREFORE, SECTION 1. All lands within the present boundaries ... are hereby added to and reserved as parts of the respective national forests","parent_excerpt":"NOW, THEREFORE, PARCEL No. 1 Beginning at US-TVA Monument 72-3 ...","explanation":"Both orders move directly from matching findings into operative inclusion of specifically described lands in a national forest."},{"child_excerpt":"The following-described land ... which is adjacent to the Nicolet National Forest, is hereby added to and reserved as a part of the said forest","parent_excerpt":"providing for the transfer ... of certain lands ... so that such lands might be included in and reserved as part of the Nantahala National Forest","explanation":"The same administrative objective and operative formulation are adapted to different forests and acquisition circumstances."}]}
